import bpy, math
from math import radians

# Clear scene
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for coll in [bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.cameras, bpy.data.lights]:
    pass

# Materials
def make_mat(name, color, rough=0.3, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    return m

MAT_YELLOW = make_mat("YellowPlastic", (1.0, 0.82, 0.02), 0.22, 0.0)
MAT_YELLOW2 = make_mat("YellowDark", (0.85, 0.68, 0.02), 0.3, 0.0)

MAT_BLACK_GLOSS = make_mat("BlackGloss", (0.01,0.01,0.01), 0.12, 0.0)
MAT_WHITE = make_mat("WhitePlastic", (0.98,0.98,0.96), 0.2, 0.0)
MAT_RIM = make_mat("EyeRim", (0.52, 0.38, 0.18), 0.35, 0.55)
MAT_SEAM = make_mat("Seam", (0.08,0.08,0.08), 0.5, 0.0)
MAT_GROUND = make_mat("Ground", (0.92,0.92,0.93), 0.9, 0.0)

def assign(obj, mat):
    if mat: obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    return obj

def smooth(obj):
    for p in obj.data.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    return obj

def add_cone(name, r1, r2, depth, loc, mat, verts=64):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=verts, radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o,mat); smooth(o); return o

def add_cyl(name, r, depth, loc, mat, verts=64, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=r, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o,mat); smooth(o); return o

def add_sphere(name, r, loc, scale, mat):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=r, location=loc, segments=48, ring_count=32)
    o = bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; assign(o,mat); smooth(o); return o

def add_box(name, dims, loc, mat, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=dims; assign(o,mat); return o

def add_torus(name, major, minor, loc, mat, rot=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor, major_segments=48, minor_segments=16, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; assign(o,mat); smooth(o); return o

def bevel(obj, width=0.02, seg=3):
    try:
        m = obj.modifiers.new("bev", 'BEVEL'); m.width=width; m.segments=seg
    except: pass
    return obj

# black base trim under body

# lower body - tapered

bevel(lower, 0.03)
# black gap band between body and head
add_cyl("GapBand", 0.795, 0.09, (0,0,1.055), MAT_BLACK)

bevel(lid, 0.015)
# top lid inner slightly domed disc

# grooves on top lid (3 thin lines toward back)

# vertical seam front center of lower body
add_box("FrontSeam", (0.012, 0.015, 0.72), (0, -0.825, 0.60), MAT_SEAM)

# coin slot back of head
add_box("CoinSlot", (0.18, 0.02, 0.028), (0, 0.795, 1.22), MAT_BLACK)
# small slot on front? no

    # sphere deformed to teardrop, flat bottom, pointed front (-Y)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=1, location=(xpos, -0.52, 0.17), segments=48, ring_count=32)
    o = bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    mesh = o.data
    for v in mesh.vertices:
        # y -1..1, front is -1
        t = (v.co.y + 1)/2.0  # 0 front, 1 back
        factor = 0.35 + 0.65 * (t**0.7)
        v.co.x *= factor * 0.22
        v.co.y *= 0.52
        v.co.z *= 0.17
        # flatten bottom
        if v.co.z < -0.11:
            v.co.z = -0.11 - (v.co.z+0.11)*0.3
    assign(o, MAT_YELLOW); smooth(o)
    return o

def make_sole(name, xpos):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=1, location=(xpos, -0.52, 0.075), segments=32, ring_count=16)
    o = bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    mesh=o.data
    for v in mesh.vertices:
        t=(v.co.y+1)/2.0
        factor=0.35+0.65*(t**0.7)
        v.co.x *= factor*0.235
        v.co.y *= 0.54
        v.co.z *= 0.05
    assign(o, MAT_BLACK); smooth(o); return o

make_sole("Sole_R", -0.62)
make_sole("Sole_L", 0.62)

        b = add_box(f"FootGroove_{side}{i}", (0.30 - i*0.04, 0.014, 0.008), (xp, yoff, 0.305 - i*0.02), MAT_YELLOW2)
        b.rotation_euler = (radians(18),0,0)

baseplat = add_box("BasePlatform", (1.45, 1.0, 0.07), (0, -0.25, 0.065), MAT_BLACK)
bevel(baseplat, 0.05)

# But ensure platform doesn't cover soles visually - it's at z 0.065 thin, ok; move feet soles slightly lower already

# ---- SHOULDERS ----
for side, xp in [("R",-0.88),("L",0.88)]:
    s = add_cyl(f"Shoulder_{side}", 0.215, 0.26, (xp, 0.02, 0.98), MAT_YELLOW, rot=(0, radians(90), 0))
    bevel(s, 0.02)
    # outer cap disc
    cap_x = xp + (-0.14 if xp<0 else 0.14)
    add_cyl(f"ShoulderCap_{side}", 0.16, 0.04, (cap_x, 0.02, 0.98), MAT_YELLOW, rot=(0, radians(90), 0))

# ---- ARMS as curves ----
def make_tube(name, points, radius=0.058):
    cu = bpy.data.curves.new(name, 'CURVE')
    cu.dimensions='3D'; cu.resolution_u=2; cu.bevel_depth=radius; cu.bevel_resolution=4; cu.fill_mode='FULL'
    sp = cu.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for i, co in enumerate(points):
        bp = sp.bezier_points[i]; bp.co=co; bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cu)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.data.materials.append(MAT_BLACK)
    return ob

# Hook arm (R, x negative): down then C curl forward/up
make_tube("ArmHook", [
    (-0.98, 0.02, 0.98),
    (-1.08, 0.02, 0.82),
    (-1.10, -0.05, 0.55),
    (-1.10, -0.22, 0.33),
    (-1.10, -0.44, 0.32),
    (-1.10, -0.52, 0.50),
    (-1.10, -0.40, 0.62),
    (-1.10, -0.28, 0.58),

# Tray arm (L, x positive): down, forward, up
make_tube("ArmTray", [
    (0.98, 0.02, 0.98),
    (1.10, 0.02, 0.80),
    (1.12, -0.18, 0.60),
    (1.12, -0.48, 0.56),
    (1.12, -0.68, 0.70),
], 0.060)

# Tray paddle (black flat spade) at end of tray arm
# main disc flattened
tray = add_cyl("CoinTray", 0.30, 0.045, (1.12, -0.88, 0.74), MAT_BLACK, rot=(0,0,0))
tray.scale = (1.0, 1.25, 1.0)
bevel(tray, 0.015)
# pointed tail at back (+Y) of tray
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=3, radius1=0.18, radius2=0.0, depth=0.28, location=(1.12, -0.48, 0.74), rotation=(radians(90),0,radians(180)))
tail = bpy.context.active_object; tail.name="TrayTail"; tail.scale=(1,1,0.18); assign(tail, MAT_BLACK)
# Actually cone orientation check - will adjust visually later; keep small

# ---- EYES ----
for side, xp in [("R",-0.29),("L",0.29)]:
    # socket black disc
    add_cyl(f"EyeSocket_{side}", 0.205, 0.06, (xp, -0.735, 1.44), MAT_BLACK_GLOSS, rot=(radians(90),0,0))
    # rim torus facing front (-Y)
    add_torus(f"EyeRim_{side}", 0.195, 0.028, (xp, -0.77, 1.44), MAT_RIM, rot=(0,0,0))
    # white eyeball sphere protruding
    eye = add_sphere(f"Eyeball_{side}", 0.185, (xp, -0.73, 1.44), (1,0.65,1), MAT_WHITE)
    # pupil black at lower front
    add_sphere(f"Pupil_{side}", 0.105, (xp, -0.845, 1.365), (1,0.55,1), MAT_BLACK_GLOSS)

# ---- TEETH (two small white buck teeth in gap) ----
for i, xp in enumerate([-0.055, 0.055]):
    add_box(f"Tooth{i}", (0.075, 0.03, 0.10), (xp, -0.795, 1.02), MAT_WHITE)

# ---- TEXT ROBIE ----
def add_text(name, body, loc, rot, size, mat, extrude=0.008):
    cu = bpy.data.curves.new(name, 'FONT'); cu.body=body; cu.size=size; cu.extrude=extrude; cu.align_x='CENTER'; cu.align_y='CENTER'
    # try bold-ish via shear? keep default
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.location=loc; ob.rotation_euler=rot; ob.data.materials.append(mat)
    return ob

# ROBIE on chest front-left area (x -0.30 as in photo)
add_text("TextROBIE", "ROBIE", (-0.31, -0.845, 0.82), (radians(90),0,0), 0.19, MAT_BLACK, 0.006)

# $ on tray top
dollar = add_text("TextDollar", "$", (1.12, -0.88, 0.775), (0,0,radians(180)), 0.32, MAT_WHITE, 0.004)
# white circle ring around $ on tray: torus flat
add_torus("TrayRing", 0.21, 0.012, (1.12, -0.88, 0.768), MAT_WHITE, rot=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1.25,0.4))

# Top text - small
toptext = add_text("TextTop", "Radio Shack", (0, 0.05, 1.805), (0,0,radians(180)), 0.11, MAT_WHITE, 0.003)
toptext2 = add_text("TextTop2", "ROBOTIC BANKER", (0, -0.10, 1.805), (0,0,radians(180)), 0.055, MAT_WHITE, 0.003)
